newsitem.title: USA: Intel cuts Fast Ethernet adapter prices.
newsitem.headline: Intel cuts Fast Ethernet adapter prices.

text.p: Intel Corp Wednesday said it was cutting prices nearly 40 percent for Fast Ethernet network adapters and nearly 20 percent in Fast Ethernet print servers.

In a statement, Intel said its 10/100Mbps PCI Fast Ethernet adapters start at $84 each, lower than most competitors' 10Mbps Ethernet adapters. Intel also reduced its price on Intel's NetportExpress PRO/100 Print Server to $499, making it the industry's first Fast Ethernet print server for under $500.
The price reductions are effective on Feb. 10, 1997.
Intel atributed the price cuts to its expertise in silicon design and fabrication and its volume manufacturing capabilities.
